title: Group and return tracks, sends, volume and pan carry over to the set
description:
As a producer, I want group and return tracks, sends, volume and pan in the set, so that the routing and balance match the score.

```gherkin
Feature: The mixer in the set
  Background:
    Given the score "mix.apr":
      """
      tempo 100
      key C
      clip a = a.wav
      clip b = b.wav
      bars 2
      track a  group beat  volume -2
        pan -30
        send plate 25%
      track b  group beat
        send plate -12dB
      group beat  volume -1  group band
      group band
      return plate  volume -4
        reverb plate 1.8s
      """

  Scenario: Group tracks, nested
    When I export "mix.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the tracks "a" and "b" are inside the group track "beat"
    And the group track "beat" is inside the group track "band"

  Scenario: Return tracks and sends
    When I export "mix.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the set has a return track "plate" with volume -4 dB
    And the track "a" sends to "plate" at 25%
    And the track "b" sends to "plate" at -12 dB
    And every other send is off

  Scenario: Volume and pan
    When I export "mix.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the track "a" has volume -2 dB and pan 30% left
    And the group track "beat" has volume -1 dB

  Scenario: A track spread over several audio tracks keeps its mix on its group
    Given the track "a" plays notes that overlap
    When I export "mix.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the group track "a" has volume -2 dB, pan 30% left and sends to "plate" at 25%
    And its audio tracks are at 0 dB, centered, with no sends
```
